blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Willoughby Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Willoughby Heights, Langley: 369 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 70 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 11 Langley communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Langley total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Willoughby Heights fell from 405 in June to 369 in September (−8.9%), and 337 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 52.8% of Langley’s 699 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Willoughby Heights?
Willoughby Heights also had 100 houses listed and 13 sold in September, against 369 condos and townhomes listed. The Willoughby Heights houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 369 condos and townhomes listed in Willoughby Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willoughby Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Willoughby Heights had a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Willoughby Heights from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 337 condos and townhomes sold in Willoughby Heights over those 4 months, out of 558 in all of Langley.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
